title: Explore the new OpenText Learning Platform experience
summary: Discover a smarter way to learn
body_markdown:
Learning should be about building skills, not searching endlessly for the right training. That’s why we’ve recently introduced a refreshed user experience across the[OpenText learning platform](https://learn.opentext.com/) , making it easier than ever to find content, navigate the platform, and discover learning opportunities tailored to your needs.


These enhancements are designed to help learners spend less time searching and more time learning, whether you’re pursuing a certification, developing new technical skills, exploring role-based learning paths, or expanding your knowledge through hands-on labs and other subscription resources.


# A fresh new look and easier navigation


One of the most noticeable changes is the platform’s updated navigation experience.


The refreshed interface introduces a cleaner, more modern design that helps learners move through the platform more intuitively. Behind the scenes, the platform’s menu structure has been reorganized to create a more consistent and streamlined experience, making it easier to access the areas and resources you use most often.


The new navigation menu on the OpenText Learning Platform


Learners will find familiar destinations in an updated menu experience designed to simplify navigation while maintaining access to the tools and learning resources they rely on every day. The updated layout also provides a more consistent experience across the platform, helping users spend less time navigating and more time learning.


The result is a simpler and more intuitive experience that helps learners stay focused on their goals and quickly access the content they need.


# Find training faster with a redesigned homepage


We’ve also reimagined the homepage experience to make learning content easier to discover.


A homepage on the OpenText Learning Platform with catalog tiles.


The redesigned homepage now features a clear set of catalog tiles that provide direct access to the content collections available within your subscription. Each tile serves as a gateway to a specific category of learning resources, making it easier to understand what’s available and where to begin.


Depending on your subscription and learning entitlements, you may see tiles for offerings such as:


- Role-Based Learning Paths


- Individual Courses


- Certification Exams


- Hands-on Labs


- Other subscription-specific content collections


Because each learner’s access may differ, the specific tiles displayed on the homepage can vary. However, the overall experience remains consistent, providing a straightforward way to browse the learning resources available to you and quickly navigate to the content that best supports your goals.


Whether you’re looking to complete a certification path, build product expertise, or explore new learning opportunities, the updated homepage provides a simpler starting point for your learning journey.


# Introducing the AI assistant


Another exciting enhancement is the introduction of the platform’s new AI assistant.


The new AI assistant window on the OpenText Learning Platform


Traditionally, learners search for training using keywords, filters, categories, or specific course titles. These tools remain available and continue to provide a powerful way to locate content. The platform’s search experience still supports keyword-based discovery and filtering to help learners narrow results and find relevant materials. In addition, learners now have the option to ask questions directly from the search bar and receive AI-assisted recommendations and responses.


The AI assistant adds a new way to discover learning.


Instead of trying to determine the right course title or search term, learners can simply describe what they want to learn using natural language. For example, a user might ask:


- “I’m preparing for the Content Manager Business Administrator certification exam. What training should I take?”


- “What courses are available to help me understand how to integrate OpenText products with SAP solutions?”


- “I’m new to OpenText Digital Asset Management. Where should I start?”


- “Show me which Documentum Administrator courses have available hands-on labs.”


The AI assistant can interpret these requests and recommend relevant learning content available within the platform. By understanding the learner’s goals and intent, it helps surface resources that may otherwise be difficult to find through traditional keyword searches alone. The AI-powered experience is designed to help users discover and explore learning content through conversational interactions while continuing to provide access to conventional search methods when preferred.


This creates a more personalized learning experience and helps connect learners with training that matches their specific needs, interests, and professional objectives.


# Designed around the learner


Together, these enhancements create a more modern learning experience focused on simplicity, accessibility, and content discovery.


Whether you’re looking for a specific course, exploring a new technology area, preparing for certification, or planning your next professional development goal, the updated OpenText Learning Platform makes it easier to find the resources that matter most.


The combination of streamlined navigation, catalog-focused homepages, traditional search tools, and the new AI assistant helps learners quickly connect with relevant content and continue their learning journey with confidence.


# [Explore the new experience](https://learn.opentext.com/)


If you haven’t visited recently, now is the perfect time to log in and explore the updated[OpenText learning platform](https://learn.opentext.com/) .


Browse the redesigned homepage, explore your available content catalogs, try the new AI assistant, and discover new ways to find the training and resources that support your learning goals.


Your next learning opportunity may be just a click, or a conversation, away.
